runs.notes: Direct grounded answer with a citation.

result.question: What is the company's annual leave policy?

parsed.answer: The company's annual leave policy for permanent employees is as follows: they are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, with entitlement increasing to 30 or 32 working days for those with 5 or more years of service, respectively. Accrual is monthly in arrears at the rate of two working days for each completed month of service for employees on the 24-day entitlement. For higher entitlements, accrual is one twelfth of the annual entitlement per completed month. Detailed accrual rules for employees joining or leaving part way through a year are set out in the Leave Accrual and Final Settlement Procedure (HR-PRO-011). Annual leave continues to accrue during the probation period. Leave requests must be submitted at least 10 working days in advance for absences of five days or more, and at least three working days in advance for shorter absences. Requests require line manager approval, and leave of more than 10 consecutive working days also requires department head approval. Unpaid leave may be granted for up to 30 calendar days in any 12-month period, during which annual leave does not accrue. Employees may carry over a maximum of 10 working days of unused annual leave into the following calendar year, with carry-over above 10 days permitted only with written approval from People Operations.

citations.quote: Permanent employees are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Annual leave accrues monthly in arrears at the rate of two working days for each completed month of service for employees on the 24-day entitlement.

Unpaid leave may be granted at the discretion of the department head for up to 30 calendar days in any 12-month period. Annual leave does not accrue during periods of unpaid leave exceeding 15 consecutive calendar days.

Employees may carry over a maximum of 10 working days of unused annual leave into the following calendar year. Carried-over days must be taken by 31 March or they are forfeited. Carry-over above 10 days is permitted only with written approval from People Operations and is granted only where the employee was prevented from taking leave by operational demands.
